newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium keeps fed govt spending steady.
newsitem.headline: Belgium keeps fed govt spending steady.

text.p: Primary spending by the Belgian federal government will hold steady at 1,020.6 billion Belgian francs in 1997, Budget Minister Herman Van Rompuy said in a statement on Friday.

Adjusted for inflation, spending declined in real terms by 1.8 percent. "For the second year running primary spending by the federal government excluding the financing of funds allotted to the European Union showed negative real growth," he said.
The government would take measures in the coming days to ensure that 1997 non-adjusted primary spending would also fall below the level of 1996, he added.
